title: Main Street, Kinnegad, Co. Westmeath, N91C2D3
seoTitle: Main Street, Kinnegad, Co. Westmeath, N91C2D3
description:
We are delighted to present this Landmark 4/5 bedroom Period Property on a generous c.0.42-acre site on Kinnegad’s main street. Boasting many historical features, this wonderful property is presented in good solid condition and has been redecorated throughout. 

Ground floor accommodation comprises of: 
Entrance Hallway: 16’ x 5’1” with feature stairs, tiled floor and alarm point.
Drawing Room: 18’9” x 13’6” with beautifully tiled fireplace.
Parlour Room: 18’9” x 12’ with impressive marble fireplace.
Office / 5th Bedroom (off Parlour): 9’10” x 8’7” with tiled floor.
Rear Hallway: 12’4” x 5’8” with tiled floor, under-stairs press and access to back yard.
Kitchen / Breakfast Room: 18’9” x 15’2” The very heart of the house with welcoming Aga Range and stove that heats the water, wooden ‘country-style’ kitchen and timber ceiling.
Guest W/C: 8’6” x 6’ partially tiled with whb and tiled floor.

First Floor accommodation comprises of:
Bedroom 1: 11’6” x 10’1” with built in closet.
Dressing Room: 10’4” x 6’11” situated just off Bedroom 1, with hotpress.
Bedroom 2: 16’4” x 11’3” with tiled fireplace and walk-in wardrobe (7’9” x 5’11”).
Bedroom 3: 18’11” c 12’11” including en-suite with w/c, whb and electric shower.
Bedroom 4: 19’ x 9’3” large double room.
Bathroom: 16’9” x 4’10” with w/c, whb, bath and hotpress.


Features: 
- A large gravel rear yard with side access, four newly constructed sheds, and a rear walled garden.
- Double-glazed windows, a comprehensive intruder alarm.
- Excellent location steps from all local amenities to include: Medical Centre, shops, supermarkets, library, GAA facilities, coffee shops/restaurants, schools, bus stops, etc.
- Dublin less than an hour.
